definitions.explanation: A teacher who works at a juku (cram school), typically helping students prepare for exams.

examples.japanese: {塾講師|じゅくこうし}のアルバイトをする。
examples.english: I work part-time as a cram school teacher.

examples.japanese: {大学生|だいがくせい}のとき、{塾講師|じゅくこうし}をしていた。
examples.english: When I was a university student, I worked as a cram school teacher.

examples.japanese: あの{塾講師|じゅくこうし}は{教|おし}え{方|かた}がうまいので{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: That cram school teacher is popular because they're good at teaching.

notes:
{塾講師|じゅくこうし} is a compound of {塾|じゅく} (cram school) and {講師|こうし} (instructor). Refers to anyone who teaches at a juku, whether full-time professional or part-time student worker.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{塾|じゅく} are private supplementary schools where students study after regular school hours, often to prepare for entrance exams. Working as a {塾講師|じゅくこうし} is one of the most common part-time jobs for university students in Japan.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {塾講師|じゅくこうし}のアルバイト: part-time juku teaching job
- {塾講師|じゅくこうし}を{募集|ぼしゅう}する: to recruit juku teachers

RELATED WORDS:
- {家庭教師|かていきょうし}: private tutor (one-on-one, visits the home)
- {予備校|よびこう}{講師|こうし}: prep school instructor (for university entrance)
- {塾|じゅく}: cram school
